name: @nord-forge/the-grid
description: A virtualized React data grid in normal document flow. React is its only peer; no runtime dependencies.
author: Nick Bevers <hello@nickbevers.dev>

scripts.build: vite build -c vite.lib.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && cp src/styles/grid.css dist/styles.css && node scripts/check-styles.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.check: npm run tsc && npm test && npm run build && npm run playground:check
scripts.playground:check: node playground/checks/vertical.mjs && node playground/checks/horizontal.mjs && node playground/checks/geometry.mjs && node playground/checks/interactive.mjs && node playground/checks/styling.mjs && node playground/checks/rows.mjs && node playground/checks/server.mjs && node playground/checks/filters.mjs && node playground/checks/groups.mjs && node playground/checks/writes.mjs && node playground/checks/views.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run tsc && npm test && npm run build
